title.zh: 信息太多，没时间整理，创作时又忘了。
title.en: Too much to capture, no time to organize, forgotten when you create.

sub.zh: 不是记不住——是散落、沉不下、用的时候调不出来。
sub.en: It isn't memory — it's scattered, never settled, and unavailable when you write.

1b.zh: 随手记在各处：聊天里、备忘录里、邮件里。要用时，翻不到。
1b.en: Jotted everywhere: chat, notes app, email. When you need it, it's gone.

2b.zh: 收藏过、读过、开过的会，没沉淀成能复用的东西，等于没发生。
2b.en: Saved, read, sat through — none of it became anything reusable, so it might as well not have happened.

3b.zh: 动笔时明明看过，却调不出来，只能重新搜一遍——而这一次往往就放弃了。
3b.en: You know you saw it, but you can't pull it up, so you search again — and usually just give up.

3tag.en: This is the link Wrisp closes
